tagline: A roof job is a $8,000–$40,000 decision, and the buying trigger falls out of the sky — a hail line, a wind event, a leak after the rain. WIN turns weather into demand: a 10-line Smart-DID grid that fires the instant a storm crosses your ZIPs, so every damaged homeowner reaches you first, before the storm-chasers roll in.

insight: a roof replacement runs $8,000–$40,000 — and demand is created by the weather, in a spike, across specific ZIPs, on a specific afternoon. The contractor who is calling and answering in that window books the neighborhood; everyone else buys the leftovers from a lead broker. A phone number that just rings can't ride a storm. A Smart DID, triggered by the weather, can.

10 tracked lines + 24/7 AI answer + SMS. Every source measured, every leak call prioritized, every missed call auto-called-back.
The storm map and your pipeline on one live dashboard — calls, texts, inspections booked, ad spend and source together.
